request.deadline: Contract year through 2026-2027; specific milestones include 52 weeks maintenance and support, 26 weeks Leios/Peras readiness, 20 weeks CIP-30, 12 weeks hardware wallet support, 8 weeks architecture assessment, and architecture assessment by Q3 2027
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node and wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, and releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Hardware wallet support for Keystone and Flex, plus newer hardware wallet models as they emerge
CIP-30 dApp connector implementation within Daedalus with documentation and interoperability verification
User support across GitHub, community forums, and direct channels, including Japanese-language support and full Japanese translation for shipped features
Test hardware acquisition and independent financial audit
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. through Intersect administration and monthly disbursement controls
request.what: Fund Daedalus Wallet maintenance and improvements for 2026-2027 as a time-and-materials engagement delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is described as Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet, running an embedded Cardano node and deriving wallet and governance data directly from chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.
Daedalus is open-source under Apache License 2.0, and the proposal says funded source code, build tooling, documentation, and release artifacts will remain public assets that anyone can fork.

The proposal says opt-in telemetry shows approximately 4,000 monthly active Daedalus users, while asserting the true count is meaningfully higher because privacy-conscious full-node users are less likely to opt in.

Se7en Labs states it assumed responsibility for Daedalus under an IOG contract in January 2026 and shipped Mithril snapshot bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, a release CLI, Nix modernization, and Daedalus 8.0 and 11.0.
The proposal commits to compatible Daedalus releases at least 2 weeks before every mainnet hard fork and to keeping cardano-node no more than 2 major versions behind mainnet recommended at any time.

The proposal says release timing and version-currency success metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain without relying on applicant self-reporting.

The requested budget totals 1,785,333 ADA, allocated as 1,666,667 ADA for labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and 52,000 ADA for the Intersect budget administration fee.
The proposal states any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.
Intersect is proposed as administrator and independent milestone verifier, with monthly disbursements against verified work and funds held in a dedicated account auditable by the Cardano community.
The proposal asserts the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

summary: The document requests 1,785,333 ADA for a one-year public-good maintenance and improvement program for Daedalus, emphasizing protocol compatibility, full-node wallet security, open-source outputs, user support, hardware wallet support, CIP-30, Japanese localisation, and Intersect-administered milestone oversight.
